text: 当地时间9月12日下午，在金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议上，国家主席习近平宣布，中国将于2027年接任金砖主席国，主办金砖国家领导人第十九次会晤。（央视）
text_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, at the first phase of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting, President Xi Jinping announced that China will take over as BRICS chair in 2027 and host the 19th BRICS Leaders' Meeting. (CCTV)
